sophie: Agreed. I'll run 10-min chunked backfills to minimize risk. Command (dry-run first):
```
./bin/backfill --job bf-8122 --chunk 10m --dry-run
```
then flip to live.
dan: I'll run the reconciliation after the backfill and produce the ledger diff report. Ping me when job is done.
lex: I'll draft a short invoice-adjustment template for Support/Sales. Auto-credit threshold = <$200; anything above routes to finance review.
maria: I'll prep customer comms for impacted accounts and coordinate with Sales for enterprise touches.
